claims.text: The hotel is about 90 minutes from Bordeaux, in the heart of the Charente region.

findings.quote: Just 90 minutes from Bordeaux, the Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa welcomes you to a place where time seems to stand still, in the heart of the magnificent Charente region.

claims.text: The Chais Monnet site dates from 1838 and is listed as a French industrial heritage site.

findings.quote: The Chais Monnet, dating from 1838, i.e. twenty years earlier, is listed as a French industrial heritage site.

claims.text: Architect Didier Poignant transformed the former industrial site into the hotel.

findings.quote: The architect Didier Poignant, transformed the industrial site into a hotel

claims.text: A glass space links the four cellars and houses the hotel's main reception functions.

findings.quote: linking the four cellars by a glass space, where all the hotel's main reception functions are now housed

claims.text: The rooms and suites are spread over four buildings and decorated in a classic French chic style.

findings.quote: Spread over four buildings, the 92 rooms and suites are decorated in a classic French chic style.

claims.text: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has a grand reception room, a dining area and cooking facilities.

findings.quote: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite offers guests a grand reception room, dining area and cooking facilities

claims.text: The pool has large floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.

findings.quote: Large floor-to-ceiling windows let in natural light and create a soothing space perfect for rest.

claims.text: Spa body treatments use Kos Paris products based on rare plants grown in an environmentally friendly way.

findings.quote: The Spa offers a selection of body treatments using Kos Paris products, based on rare plants, grown in an environmentally friendly way.

claims.text: The spa offers Nougatine treatments for children aged 3 to 12.

findings.quote: These natural, gourmet-perfumed treatments from Nougatine, for children aged 3 to 12, are adapted to the specific needs of their delicate skin.

claims.text: The rooftop of Bar 1838 overlooks the city of Cognac.

findings.quote: Perched above Cognac, the rooftop of Bar 1838 offers an exceptional view of the city.

claims.text: Several times a month, Bar 1838 hosts evening events exploring its partner cognac houses.

findings.quote: Several times a month, Bar 1838 hosts the
a series of evening events dedicated to exploring its partner cognac houses

claims.text: The hotel is pet-friendly.

findings.quote: Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa is pet-friendly!

claims.text: The site's historic features include the Grand Chai des Foudres, known as the Cathedral, with its remarkable framework.

findings.quote: the "Grand Chai des Foudres", known as the "Cathedral", with its remarkable framework

claims.text: The spa has an indoor and outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, saunas, steam rooms, experience showers and a fitness center.

findings.quote: the Spa is a true invitation to relaxation and well-being with its indoor and outdoor pool, jacuzzi, saunas, steam rooms, experience showers, four treatment rooms, and fitness center.

claims.text: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has privileged access to a private treatment room for massages by the spa therapists.

findings.quote: The ultimate refinement, our suite offers privileged access to a private treatment room where our guests can enjoy a massage by one of our SPA therapists.
our Jean Gabriel Monnet Presidential Suite boasts

claims.text: The hotel's gardens are the work of landscape designer Louis Benech.

findings.quote: the hotel's gardens, sublimated by the talent of renowned landscape designer Louis Benech

claims.text: The cellars bear the name Monnet, a reference to Jean Monnet, who began his professional career there.

findings.quote: They are also emblematic for the name they bear: Monnet, a reference to Jean Monnet, the world-famous Cognac winegrower who began his professional career here.

claims.text: The pool will be closed from January 4 to 10, 2027 for annual maintenance.

findings.quote: the pool will be closed on an exceptional basis from January 4 to 10, 2027, for its annual maintenance

claims.text: The rooftop closes for the winter season, when Bar 1838 welcomes guests instead.

findings.quote: Le Rooftop has closed for the winter season.
during the winter season, Bar 1838 takes over from the Rooftop to welcome you.

claims.text: Elegant attire is required at the Les Foudres restaurant; casual or sportswear is not permitted.

findings.quote: Out of respect for our Michelin-starred establishment and our guests, elegant attire is required. Casual or sportswear is not permitted.
